## History
- **The Sundering.** Volcanic eruptions centuries ago shattered a single landmass into dozens of islands, scattering survivors across the archipelago
- **Rise of the Pirate Clans.** Without centralized rule, harbor towns became footholds for rival pirate clans vying for control of trade routes
- **The Obsidian Pact.** A short-lived alliance of three clans that briefly united the islands — collapsed when its architect was assassinated
- **Ongoing Conflict.** Clan warfare intensifies as volcanic activity resurges, shrinking habitable land and driving competition over resources

## Settlements
- Ashport — largest harbor town, contested territory between two clans
- Cinderhaven — fortified port built into a dormant caldera
- Reefwatch — remote fishing village clinging to the outermost islands

## Factions & Powers
- **The Emberclaw Clan.** Most aggressive pirate fleet, controls the northern straits
- **The Tideweavers.** Smugglers and information brokers operating from hidden coves
- **The Ashen Circle.** Volcanic cult that worships the islands' destructive power
